1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, __wherein the cooling system is configured to be mounted within the wall between the studs using fastening elements__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

3. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately__ twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, __and the cooling system is configured to evaporatively cool air passing through the moistened pad__.

5. (Previously Presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation.

6. (Previously Presented) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through an opening.

7. (Previously Presented) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation.

8. (Previously Presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Previously Presented) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Previously Presented) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes a front cover __for enclosing the internal components__.

12. (Previously Presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is a load-bearing wall __and the cooling system is mounted between studs of the load-bearing wall__.

14. (Previously Presented) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1 ; mounting elements __including fastening elements for securing the cooling system between wall studs__; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Previously Presented) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: __a housing configured for mounting within a structure wall between wall studs, the housing containing a water reservoir, a pump, a pad, a water distributor, a motor, and a fan that together form an evaporative cooling system for cooling an indoor area__.

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is configured for mounting by placing the housing between wall studs spaced __approximately__ sixteen inches on center.

19. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing is configured for mounting within a structure wall, the structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF).

20. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.
